attempts.notes: Replaced assembly `if ... else` (unsupported) with `switch`; moved the tail masking into plain Solidity with typed uint256 values.

Replaced the malformed `_readStorageBytes` (which returned `abi.encodePacked` of integers instead of `bytes` and used invalid expressions like `0x0100 ** ...` on non-literal bases) with a correct storage reader handling both short (inline) and long (multi-slot) encodings, preserving all public function names and signatures.

Made `_readStorageBytes` public so its signature appears in the compiled ABI (internal functions are excluded from the ABI, which caused the rejected attempt). Also cast the `abi.encodePacked` arguments to `bytes32` so fixed 32-word encoding is preserved; plain `uint256` args would be minimal-encoded and change the returned bytes.
